notes.title: Updated Demo! v0.2.1 Now Available!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce a new demo version available for free!

Changelog
v0.2.1
- Added new content for Harumi and Reiko's routes
- New location [Hollow Dimension Bar Aokan]
- 2 new erotic scenes
- Add party members to your combat team
- Start a new game from the beginning of the newest content!
- Ability to skip erotic scenes containing male characters
- Tweaked and balanced player/enemy stats
- Various bug fixes

Please be aware that at this early stage of development there may be glitches or bugs present. Be sure to let us know if you encounter any problems so we can strive to fix them.
